newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates moderately traded on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates moderately traded on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were moderately traded on Monday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus no barges traded on Friday.
- Two barges, this week, lower Ohio River, bid 155 percent of tariff, offered 170 percent.
- Two barges, this week, Illinois river, no bid, offered 165 percent.
- Two barges, next week, Mid-Mississippi, (Osceola through Cairo), no bid, offered 170 percent.
- Two barges, next week, lower Ohio river, bid 165 percent, offered 182-1/2 percent.
- Four barges, one each week of October, Illinois river, bid 222-1/2 percent down 2-1/2 percentage points, no offer.
